segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ קוֹשְׁרִין נִימָא בַּמִּקְדָּשׁ, אֲבָל לֹא בַּמְּדִינָה. וְאִם בַּתְּחִילָּה — כָּאן וְכָאן אָסוּר.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «One» may «tie up» on Shabbat «a string [nima]» that came loose from a harp used «in the Temple, but not in» the rest of «the country. And» tying the string to the harp for «the first time is prohibited» both «here and there.»

moves.summary: tying a harp string permitted only in the Temple

positions.claim: a broken harp string may be tied in the Temple only; first-time tying prohibited everywhere
